description: Free video clips and B-roll, including 4K, archival and public domain footage.
description_zh: 免费视频片段与 B-roll，含 4K、历史档案与公有领域素材。

entries.name: Pexels Videos
entries.description: Free HD and 4K stock videos with a very permissive license.
entries.description_zh: 免费高清与 4K 视频素材，许可非常宽松。

entries.name: Pixabay Videos
entries.description: Large free footage library including motion graphics and loops.
entries.description_zh: 大型免费视频库，含动态图形与循环背景。

entries.name: Mixkit Video
entries.description: Free HD clips plus Premiere, After Effects and DaVinci templates.
entries.description_zh: 免费高清片段，另附 Premiere、After Effects 与 DaVinci 模板。

entries.name: Coverr
entries.description: Free cinematic clips originally built for website backgrounds.
entries.description_zh: 免费电影感片段，最初为网站背景视频而生。

entries.name: Videvo
entries.description: Free footage and motion graphics with per-asset licenses.
entries.description_zh: 免费视频素材与动态图形，逐项标注许可。
entries.notes: Watch the per-asset license label; CC-BY items require attribution.
entries.notes_zh: 注意逐条许可标签；CC-BY 条目需署名。

entries.name: Videezy
entries.description: Free HD and 4K clips, most requiring an attribution link.
entries.description_zh: 免费高清/4K 片段，多数要求署名链接。

entries.name: Vidsplay
entries.notes: Cannot be redistributed as stock footage elsewhere.
entries.notes_zh: 不得在其他平台作为图库素材二次分发。

entries.name: Dareful
entries.description_zh: 人工精选的免费 4K 视频片段。

entries.name: Life of Vids
entries.description: Free artistic clips released by an advertising agency.
entries.description_zh: 广告工作室发布的免费艺术感片段。

entries.name: Mazwai
entries.description: Curated cinematic footage, hand-picked from videographers.
entries.description_zh: 从摄影师处精选的电影感素材。

entries.name: SplitShire
entries.description: Free photos and videos by photographer Daniel Nanescu.
entries.description_zh: 摄影师 Daniel Nanescu 的免费照片与视频。
entries.notes_zh: 不得作为图库二次分发。

entries.name: NASA Image and Video Library
entries.description: Public domain space footage, launch videos and Earth imagery.
entries.description_zh: 公有领域的太空影像、发射视频与地球画面。
entries.notes: NASA media is generally not copyrightable; identifiable people need care.
entries.notes_zh: NASA 素材一般不受版权保护；含可识别人物时需谨慎。

entries.name: Prelinger Archives
entries.description: Historic advertising, educational and amateur films, mostly public domain.
entries.description_zh: 历史广告、教育与业余影片，多为公有领域。

entries.name: Pond5 Public Domain Project
entries.description: Free historic and archival media in the public domain.
entries.description_zh: 公有领域的历史与档案媒体。

entries.name: ESA Multimedia
entries.description: European Space Agency videos and images of Earth and space.
entries.description_zh: 欧洲航天局的地球与太空视频、图片。
